subject: W4 spine landed; Praxis has NO TUI boundary contract (owner correction); Continuity now reads real SessionSpaces
result: OWNER CORRECTION ACCEPTED AND VERIFIED: my earlier claim that Praxis has real owner contracts on main for the TUI to consume was wrong. crates/aikit-core/src/praxis.rs exists (resolve_praxis, PraxisResolution, SelectedMethod, explain_praxis) but NOTHING of it crosses the TUI application boundary — ApplicationService publishes search, relations, knowledge, preview/apply, explain, history and contextual actions only, and crates/aikit-tui contains ZERO references to praxis, skillset or method. Praxis is boundary plumbing that does not exist, not a slice to consume. The spine now encodes that fact rather than my assumption. MERGED: #240 (d374d6d) 5.1 Preview; #243 (827c906) Compose becomes the 5.1 ten-step spine. OPENED #244: Continuity step reads real SessionSpaces. THE SPINE MODEL: ComposeStep (10 steps, spec order) x StepStanding (Determined | Open | NotExposed). The Open/NotExposed split is the load-bearing distinction — Open sends a person to make a choice, NotExposed says no contract publishes that choice here; collapsing them sends someone after a picker that does not exist. Distinct marks in both glyph sets, unit-tested. NotExposed on this boundary, each checked not assumed: Praxis (no Profile/SkillSet/Skill/Method contract; its Capabilities/Actions tail DOES resolve and is still named), Intention (no intention capture), Enter work (no session-start contract; Factory route blocked on #227). Continuity is deliberately NOT NotExposed — SessionSpaceApplicationProjection is published — and a test pins that, so a future regression to NotExposed fails loudly. Progress counts against actionable steps, never all ten, or unexposed steps read as work the person failed to do. RETIRED: the four read-model horizon count rows in Compose. They said strictly less than the spine rows replacing them, and at tested pane heights keeping both pushed the persons own selected Resource off the pane. ComposeHorizon still owns the horizons as a read-model grouping; it was never the spine. NEW SHAPE: WorkspaceReading { world, session_spaces } replaces the bare &ProjectWorldReadModel on the render path so sections can consume further owner read models without a parameter per step. KNOWN WEAKNESS, recorded at the field not hidden: session_space_discover is fallible and a failed read currently lands as an empty roster, indistinguishable from none-exist; the surface has nowhere honest to put a read failure yet. TEST DISCIPLINE LEARNED TWICE: the Compose/preview panes are narrow and Wrap reflows prose, so rendered-buffer assertions can only hold for row labels (first token on their line); exact content must be unit-tested. NEXT: the remaining actionable spine steps (Identity, Governance, Information, Worlds/bounds, Runtime) deepen from counts into selections; Praxis needs an application-boundary contract before it can move at all.
